item.title: Video shows moments before fatal crash between jet, fire truck at LaGuardia Airport
item.description: Just before an Air Canada jet collided with an airport fire truck, air traffic controllers at New York’s LaGuardia Airport were juggling a developing late night emergency on the runway.

item.title: 3 pets dead, 8 people left homeless after lithium-ion battery sparks fire in Lakeland
item.description: A home was completely destroyed due to a fire caused by a lithium-ion battery left charging in Lakeland Saturday afternoon, according to the Red Cross and the family living there.

item.description: FORT LAUDERDALE, Fla. item.title: Person found with gunshot wound in Ybor parking garage
item.description: TAMPA, Fla. (WFLA)— A person was found with a gunshot wound in a parking garage in Ybor City. The Tampa Police Department responded to Centro Ybor parking garage a little before 2 a.m. Tuesday regarding reports of a gunshot victim. TPD said the victim is hospitalized.

item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates (AP) — A missile slammed into a street in central Tel Aviv as Iran kept up its barrages targeting Israel and Gulf Arab states on Tuesday, even as U.S. President Donald Trump said the United States was in talks with the Islamic Republic to end the war. item.title: Pam Bondi issues statement on Attorney General exit
item.description: President Donald Trump has confirmed that Pam Bondi is out as his attorney general.

item.title: Husband shot Florida Democratic Party vice chair, wrapped her body in garbage bags: police
item.description: The husband of a South Florida vice mayor has been charged with fatally shooting his wife at their home, according to a police affidavit.

item.title: Lawsuit challenges new Florida version of SAVE America Act
item.description: A new lawsuit has been filed challenging a recently enacted Florida law that mirrors the language of the federal Safeguard American Voter Eligibility (SAVE America) Act — President Trump’s self-described “No. 1” legislative priority.

item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth asked the Army’s chief of staff, Gen. Randy George, to step down from the post and retire immediately, a Pentagon official told The Hill on Thursday. item.title: Conservationists push back against Trump admin vote to allow offshore drilling in Gulf
item.description: This week, the Trump Administration voted to exempt oil and gas drilling in the Gulf from the Endangered Species Act, causing concern for environmental conservation groups in Florida.

item.title: Teen threatens Polk County school after boyfriend arrested for bringing gun on campus: arrest papers
item.description: Two teenagers were arrested on Thursday after staff found a gun at Bartow High School, and later discovered a threatening social media post.

item.title: Publix makes Fortune's list of best companies to work for
item.description: A supermarket chain with Florida roots may be more than just a favorite spot for some grocery shoppers, with the company also earning applause from its employees.

item.title: Sarasota County deputies shoot suspect after he pulls gun out of waistband: officials
item.description: A suspect was shot by Sarasota County deputies Thursday evening after officials said he took out a gun and refused commands to drop the weapon.

item.title: Phillies unveil proposed $205 million renovations to BayCare Ballpark
item.description: The Philadelphia Phillies have proposed $205 million in renovations to BayCare Ballpark, the home of spring training and the MLB team's Single-A affiliate, the Clearwater Threshers.

item.title: Stetson alumni call on college to create 'distance' from Bondi after she was ousted as Attorney General
item.description: A coalition of Stetson University College of Law alumni are calling on the college to distance itself from Pam Bondi after she was ousted as U.S. Attorney General.
